phase_0.boundary_condition: The asymptotic boundary at spatial infinity plus the Cauchy surface on which initial data close; together they contain the self-consistent metric, its stress-energy source, and the unique winding.
phase_0.domain_name: gravity as a fundamental expression of fixed-point winding a
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: stress-energy tensor T_{μν} mapped forward into Ricci curvature R_{μν}
AFWD.justification: It is the directed transformation from source distribution to curvature target in the Einstein constraint.

AREV.chosen_element: geodesic deviation equation carrying curvature back to tidal acceleration between neighboring worldlines
AREV.justification: It is the descent from global curvature to local relative acceleration, the contravariant readout of the same field.

CLINK.chosen_element: contracted Bianchi identity composed with covariant conservation of stress-energy
CLINK.justification: It chains curvature geometry to source conservation so the constraint remains consistent under one composition.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: self-consistency condition in which stress-energy sources curvature and curvature constrains stress-energy simultaneously
ENGAGR.justification: It holds both directions at once: the source is cause and consequence of the same winding, kept live before the fixed point is selected.

EVALF.chosen_element: non-conserved or boundary-flux-violating source that fails to close the constraint
EVALF.justification: It anchors the negative arm where the would-be winding cannot satisfy ∇^μ T_{μν}=0 and the asymptotic falloff.

EVALT.chosen_element: positive-energy source producing attractive curvature and an inverse-square far field
EVALT.justification: It anchors the affirmative arm where stress-energy and curvature match under the dominant energy condition.

FFUSE.chosen_element: Einstein tensor equation G_{μν}=8πG T_{μν} joining curvature and source
FFUSE.justification: The arms rejoin into one resolved constraint; if curvature and source disagree the join holds both together rather than dropping either.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: self-consistent constraint surface opening into a curvature arm and a stress-energy arm
FSPLIT.justification: It splits the one constraint into the geometric winding that produces curvature and the source distribution that seeds it.

IFIX.chosen_element: solved metric recorded on the Cauchy evolution as the permanent spacetime geometry
IFIX.justification: It is the irreversible fixation of the unique winding; once evolution is appended, the geometry cannot be unwound.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: local inertial frame in which gravitational and inertial motion coincide
IMSCRIB.justification: It is the identity point of the theory: the metric recognizes itself through the equivalence principle without transforming the field.

TANCH.chosen_element: asymptotically flat spatial infinity with fixed ADM mass and zero flux
TANCH.justification: It seals the whole field: all curvature and source content is contained by the boundary falloff conditions and no gravitational flux escapes.

VINIT.chosen_element: bare differentiable four-manifold before a metric or source is assigned
VINIT.justification: It is the initial object: no curvature, no stress-energy, no winding, and no constraint has yet been named.

phase_2.fuse_result: a single self-consistent metric whose inverse-square field is fixed by the source; conflicting arms rejoin to B and this need not recreate the split_input contents
phase_2.rejoin_note: The curvature arm builds geometry and the source arm enforces conservation and falloff; they rejoin in the Einstein constraint. The kernel runs this word over SIXTEEN_3 and returns the B4 value.
phase_2.split_element: self-consistent constraint surface opening into curvature arm and stress-energy arm
phase_2.split_input: seeding configuration: a stress-energy distribution on a Cauchy surface with asymptotic falloff conditions
split_outputs: curvature arm that constructs R_{μν} and the Einstein tensor
stress-energy arm that enforces ∇^μ T_{μν}=0 and the energy conditions
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: stress-energy sources curvature and curvature constrains stress-energy in the same field, held together as a live self-consistency that resolves to a single metric or to B.
phase_3.false_description: the proposed source violates conservation or boundary flux, so no self-consistent curvature winding is constructively refuted.
phase_3.true_description: the metric and stress-energy satisfy G_{μν}=8πG T_{μν} with conserved source and asymptotically flat falloff; the winding is constructively affirmed.
phase_3.void_description: bare manifold with no metric, no source, no curvature, no winding; no constraint is established.

steps.domain_action: bare differentiable manifold with no metric, no connection, no stress-energy, no winding.
local inertial frame identifies gravitational and inertial motion as the same free fall.
stress-energy distribution advances into a tentative source tensor T_{μν}.
constraint surface opens into curvature arm and stress-energy arm.
curvature arm constructs Ricci tensor R_{μν} from metric derivatives and affine connection.
stress-energy arm tests covariant conservation ∇^μ T_{μν}=0 and rejects non-conserved sources.
curvature and source arms rejoin in Einstein tensor equation G_{μν}=8πG T_{μν}, with mismatches held together.
contracted Bianchi identity composes with source conservation to keep the constraint consistent.
curvature descends through geodesic deviation to tidal acceleration between nearby worldlines.
asymptotic boundary opens into an ADM mass arm and a flux arm.
mass arm fixes total mass from the inverse-square falloff of the metric.
flux arm checks that no gravitational flux escapes through spatial infinity.
boundary arms rejoin into asymptotically flat boundary conditions with fixed ADM charges.
stress-energy sourcing curvature and curvature constraining stress-energy are held together as the self-consistent fixed point.
the constraint is solved forward to the weak-field potential Φ = -GM/r and its inverse-square field.
the unique winding returns the seeding configuration through μ∘δ as a structural identity.
the solved metric is frozen on the Cauchy evolution as permanent spacetime geometry.
asymptotic spatial infinity seals the metric, source, and winding into one closed field.

phase_5.alfs_store: the equivalence principle and Einstein field equations as the bootstrap reference for every self-consistent winding.
phase_5.compiler_frontend: the Einstein constraint solver that translates a stress-energy distribution and boundary data into a metric.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the covariant derivative and contracted Bianchi identity that carry information between curvature and source sectors.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the Cauchy surface and its evolved spatial slices storing three-metric, extrinsic curvature, and stress-energy.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the initial data constraint hierarchy determining which variables are solved first: Hamiltonian constraint, momentum constraint, then evolution.

phase_6.cycle_cost: one constraint evaluation consuming a metric derivative, a source tensor contraction, and a boundary falloff check.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0: the winding is a fixed-point map, so the constraint cycle trades source and curvature without net creation or destruction; the B4 value is computed by the kernel.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: residual evaluated on the constraint surface with curvature and source either matched or held in contradiction.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: tentative metric and stress-energy on a Cauchy surface before the constraint is enforced.
